title: TikTok Shop Guide: How to Sell, Set Up Seller Center, and Grow With Creators
summary: A complete TikTok Shop guide for beginners: set up Seller Center free, list products, understand fees, and use creator outreach to drive your first sales.
body_markdown:
## How to Set Up TikTok Shop Seller Center: A Step-by-Step Walkthrough


Register through TikTok Shop Seller Center, submit the requested identity or business records, complete verification, then configure your storefront, payout details, and shipping settings. Gather documents first so you can enter information accurately and respond quickly to correction requests.


### Step 1: Register Your Seller Center Account (Documents You Need Before You Start)


Open the official Seller Center registration flow and choose the seller type that matches your business. Prepare government-issued identification for an individual application, or the requested formation and registration records for a business. Have your legal name, business address, contact details, tax information, and bank account details ready. Exact requirements vary by seller type and the instructions shown during registration.


Enter information as it appears on supporting documents. Use a business email address you can monitor, and save access credentials securely. You can start online through Seller Center; the TikTok Shop seller app is another way to manage shop activity by phone.


### Step 2: Pass Business Verification Without Rejections (Common Mistakes and Fixes)


Review every field before submitting. A name that differs from an identity or business record, an incomplete address, an expired document, or a blurry image can trigger rejection or resubmission. Upload the full document in the requested format and quality, and check that key details are legible.


If TikTok flags an application, read the specific reason in Seller Center and correct that item rather than creating a second application with conflicting details. Keep original records nearby while editing. Approval timing varies, so monitor your application status and account messages; submission does not mean the shop is approved.


### Step 3: Set Up Your Shop Profile, Bank Details, and Shipping Settings


After verification, add a recognizable shop name, profile image, and customer-facing contact information. Set up payouts with an account that matches seller details, then review shipping options, handling expectations, and service locations. Clear policies and realistic dispatch settings help prevent missed deadlines and customer confusion.


Before publishing products, check that your profile, payment details, and shipping configuration are complete. The FastMoss TikTok Data Analytics Platform may support category and creator research as you plan beyond setup. That research is separate from Seller Center’s required account configuration.


### Step 4: Seller Center Desktop vs. the TikTok Seller Mobile App: Which to Use First


Start on desktop to review application fields, upload documents, configure shop details, or manage a larger catalog. Use the mobile seller app for on-the-go checks and routine tasks. Both support seller operations, but a phone is less convenient for comparing records or handling extensive setup.


Tool Best suited to Use it when


Seller Center on desktop Registration, document review, shop configuration, and detailed catalog work You are launching or making changes that need careful review.


TikTok Shop seller app Mobile access to shop tasks and account activity You need to check or manage the shop while away from a computer.


You do not need to begin with the mobile app. Choose the interface that makes document review and accurate data entry easiest, then add mobile access if it suits your workflow.
